descEn: Interbrand-style global top 10 consumer brands plus three official press links each.
descZh: 参考 Interbrand「全球最佳品牌」价值榜常见前十，每牌三条官网新闻稿或博文外链。
h1Zh: 全球品牌价值前十（Interbrand 口径）
editorialHtmlEn:
Ten names usually clustered at the top of Interbrand’s “Best Global Brands” value ranking; order tweaks when they republish the annual table.

Valuation moves with equity markets and product cycles. This page is a bookmark rail — not investment research and not a recommendation to buy, hold, or sell any security.

Last reviewed: 2026-05-19. I do not rank brands by ad spend or sponsorship; links point to corporate homepages or newsrooms only.

Press PDFs and campaign microsites are not mirrored here — only the three outbound story links per row that I actually read.
editorialHtmlZh:
十个名字大致对应 Interbrand《全球最佳品牌》年度价值榜里常见的前排；他们发新榜后再微调顺序。

品牌价值随市场与业务周期波动。本页只是外链书签条，不构成投资建议，亦不代表买入、持有或卖出任何证券。

最近核对：2026-05-19。不按广告或赞助排序；链接仅指向企业官网或新闻稿入口。

新闻稿 PDF 与 campaign 微站不在本站转载，每行三条外链是我自己会点进去看的稿件入口。
rankLeadEn: Large consumer names that Interbrand-style tables tend to pin near the top — order tracks their public league table, not my taste.
rankLeadZh: Interbrand 一类榜单里常见的大消费品牌；顺序跟公开榜单梯队走，与个人偏好无关。
newsLeadEn: Press highlights pulled from each company’s own corporate newsroom or investor relations feed.
newsLeadZh: 每条下为各公司官网新闻室或投资者关系侧的一手稿摘要入口。
moreLeadEn: Extra logos for quick jumps — grouping is alphabetical here; spacing does not imply a second-tier ranking.
moreLeadZh: 补充若干常用品牌官网入口；此处多为按字母或编辑习惯分组，不代表次级排名先后。
